facts.text: Il Borro is a thousand-year-old hamlet in the heart of Tuscany.
facts.excerpt: In the heart of Tuscany lies Il Borro, a thousand-year-old hamlet

facts.text: Il Borro was a fortress in the 12th century.
facts.excerpt: An impregnable fortress in the 12th century

facts.text: In 1993 Duke Amedeo di Savoia-Aosta ceded ownership to Ferruccio Ferragamo, who promoted a restoration of the estate.
facts.excerpt: in 1993 ceded ownership to Ferruccio Ferragamo, the promoter of a majestic restoration and renovation of the estate

facts.text: Il Borro is in the heart of Valdarno di Sopra, a natural basin bordered by the Pratomagno ridge.
facts.excerpt: in the heart of Valdarno Di Sopra: a wide natural basin marked by the passage of the river of the same name and bordered by the Apennine ridge of Pratomagno

facts.text: Il Borro is part of Relais & Chateaux.
facts.excerpt: Il Borro is part of the Relais & Châteaux circuit

facts.text: Accommodation includes the Dimora Storica, Villa Casetta, suites within the medieval village and suites at Aie del Borro.
facts.excerpt: the exclusive Dimora Storica, Villa Casetta, the 38 elegant and refined suites within the medieval village and the 20 new suites “Aie del Borro”

facts.text: Villa Mulino is immersed in the woods and Villa Casetta sits among the Merlot vineyards.
facts.excerpt: the characteristic Villa Mulino immersed in the woods, the romantic Villa Casetta among the Merlot vineyards

facts.text: Local artisans such as a goldsmith, shoemaker and restorer have reopened their stores in the medieval village.
facts.excerpt: local artisans such as the goldsmith, shoemaker and restorer have reopened their stores in the medieval village

facts.text: Craft workshops let guests take part in making small handmade pieces.
facts.excerpt: Craft workshops allow guests to actively participate in the creation of small handmade productions and teach age-old crafts.

facts.text: Wine experiences include tastings, the Wine & Art Gallery, vineyard itineraries and visits to the old barrique cellar.
facts.excerpt: tastings of our winery’s fine labels, the Wine & Art Gallery, vineyard itineraries and visits to the old barrique cellar

facts.text: Il Borro has been certified organic since 2015.
facts.excerpt: Since 2015, Il Borro is certified organic

facts.text: The estate has 85 hectares of vineyards between 300 and 500 meters above sea level.
facts.excerpt: Spread over 85 hectares of vineyards between 300 and 500 meters above sea level

facts.text: More than 100 beehives are located on the estate.
facts.excerpt: More than 100 beehives are also located on the estate

facts.text: Il Borro offers horseback riding lessons for experienced riders and beginners.
facts.excerpt: Our horses are suitable for everyone, experienced or beginner, organizing lessons tailored to your level.

facts.text: The estate has trails, bike routes, tennis, soccer and golf.
facts.excerpt: the estate has plenty of trails to explore, routes to bike, tennis, soccer and golf courses

facts.text: Cooking classes are designed for adults and children.
facts.excerpt: Our cooking classes, designed for adults and children

facts.text: Children's activities can be done with parents or supervised by a professional babysitter.
facts.excerpt: who can do them together with their parents or supervised by a professional baby sitter

facts.text: Osteria del Borro offers a gourmet menu and Il Borro Tuscan Bistro a more traditional menu, both farm-to-table.
facts.excerpt: A gourmet menu offered by Osteria del Borro and a more traditional menu at Il Borro Tuscan Bistro.

facts.text: Guided truffle hunting experiences are available with tasting and lunch.
facts.excerpt: Available, guided experiences in Valdarno, Casentino, Cortona, Montepulciano and Tuoro with tasting and lunch.

facts.text: Guided tours visit Florence, San Gimignano, Volterra, Siena and the Chianti area.
facts.excerpt: Guided tours dedicated to the discovery of major Tuscan cities: Florence, San Gimignano, Volterra, Siena and the entire Chianti area.

facts.text: The I Borrigiani farmhouses are 1.5 km from the main facility and services.
facts.excerpt: 1.5km from the main facility and services

facts.text: Il Borro has retained its Two Michelin Keys.
facts.excerpt: Il Borro is delighted to announce that it has retained its Two MICHELIN Keys

facts.text: Event spaces include the village square, the Italian garden, the swimming pool and the amphitheater.
facts.excerpt: from the village square, to the charming Italian garden; from the terrace near the Mansion, to the swimming pool; from the scenic Tuscan Bistro, to the amphitheater

facts.text: Tennis at Il Borro is on two courts among olive groves and vineyards.
facts.excerpt: Due campi immersi nel verde della campagna toscana, tra uliveti e vigneti
